name: Auralise
description: Auralise the room scene by convolving the impulse response with the source signal(s) and decoding to the chosen output format.

inputParameters.name: signals
inputParameters.description: Optional source signal(s). If not provided, it will take the signal(s) from the Source object(s) in the scene.

inputParameters.name: multiconvolve
inputParameters.description: Whether to convolve multiple signals with multiple impulse responses. If False, it will convolve each signal with the corresponding impulse response.

inputParameters.name: save_file_path
inputParameters.description: File path to save the convolved signal(s). Default is the current working directory.

inputParameters.name: save_file_name
inputParameters.description: File name for the saved convolved signal(s). Default is 'convolved_sound'.

inputParameters.name: save
inputParameters.description: Whether to save the convolved signal(s) to a file.

inputParameters.name: output_format
inputParameters.description: Output format: 'stereo' (default, loudspeakers), 'binaural' (headphones, needs ambisonic impulse responses), 'mono', or 'ambisonics' (multichannel file only, cannot be played).

inputParameters.name: hrtf
inputParameters.description: HRTF set for binaural output: 'kemar_normal_pinna' (default), 'kemar_large_pinna', or the path to a .sofa file.

inputParameters.name: level
inputParameters.description: Output level: 'relative' (default) applies one gain to all signals of this run so the loudest peaks at -1 dBFS, keeping distance and level differences; 'individual' brings each signal to -1 dBFS; 'none' keeps the raw level and may clip.

outputParameters.name: signals
outputParameters.description: Auralised signal(s) in the output format, shaped (samples, channels).

outputParameters.name: sample_rate
outputParameters.description: Sample rate of each auralised signal, in Hz.
